multiboot2_module.load_mechanism: GRUB2 module2 directive in grub.cfg: 'module2 /boot/test.gguf gguf_model'
multiboot2_module.discovery: Kernel walks MB2 tag list from multiboot_info pointer, finds type=3 MODULE tag

boot_output: [PASS] GGUF header valid on bare metal
[SAM OS] Sprint 6 PASS -- GGUF header parsed on bare metal

significance.what_this_proves: SAM OS can locate a GGUF model file loaded by GRUB2 as a multiboot2 module, read its physical address from the MB2 tag list, and parse the header — magic, version, tensor count, metadata count — directly from raw memory bytes. No filesystem driver. No libc. No OS. The kernel IS the model loader.
significance.physical_address: GRUB placed the 292-byte file at 0x10C000. The kernel found it by walking the MB2 tag list and cast the address to a gguf_header_t pointer. Zero copies. Zero allocations.
significance.path_to_real_inference: Next: copy a real quantized GGUF (GPT-2 small Q8_0, ~120MB) into the ISO, parse the full metadata KV section to extract context_length and embedding_dim, then locate the first weight tensor offset. Sprint 8: load tensor into AI domain and run a matmul against it.
